## Staff ML Platform Engineer
**Example Analytics**

Staff ML Platform Engineer at Example Analytics (Remote). Requires 5+ years building ML platforms and data pipelines.

job.title: Staff ML Platform Engineer
job.requirementsSummary: Requires 5+ years building ML platforms and data pipelines.
job.description: Example Analytics builds semantic search infrastructure for example data. About the role: you will own the technical strategy for the end-to-end ML platform lifecycle, from feature development and training data to offline experimentation. What you'll do: define architecture and technical standards across batch and streaming computation; partner with platform teams to resolve ambiguity. Who you might be: 5+ years in infrastructure or ML platforms; 2+ years building production ML infrastructure; deep experience with distributed data systems such as Spark and Kubernetes. Benefits: healthcare, 401k with employer match, flexible vacation. Pay range: $180,000 — $240,000 USD.
